UI.TITLE: Backlog Sections
UI.INTRO: One set of named sections, used by the backlog of every project. Each backlog shows every section as a header above its tasks; put a task in a section there, by dragging it under a header or with the keyboard shortcuts for moving a task. Which task sits in which section is kept per project. Sections and memberships are stored by the plugin; the app’s tasks are only reordered, never changed.

SECTIONS.HEADING: Sections
SECTIONS.HINT: One list for every project, in this order from the top of the backlog; tasks without a section come last. Which tasks are in a section is decided in the project backlog itself, not here.
SECTIONS.DELETE_CONFIRM_BODY: The section "{{name}}" is removed from every project. Its {{count}} tasks stay in their backlog, without a section.

PRESET.HINT: Adds the four horizon sections at once; a section with the same name is left alone.

OPTIONS.HEADING: Behaviour
OPTIONS.HEADER_BUTTON: Show the Backlog sections button in the app header
OPTIONS.HEADER_BUTTON_HINT: The button appears in project views and opens this page. A change takes effect after a restart of the app.
OPTIONS.CLICK_SELECTS: One click selects a task, two clicks edit its name
OPTIONS.CLICK_SELECTS_HINT: Without this, clicking a task name opens it for editing straight away. The option applies everywhere in the app, not only in the backlog.
OPTIONS.MOVE_DUE: Move tasks scheduled for this week out of the backlog
OPTIONS.MOVE_DUE_HINT: A backlog task with a due date in the current week (Monday to Sunday) moves to the top of the project's task list — once per task per week, so putting it back in the backlog keeps it there until next week. Older overdue dates stay put.
OPTIONS.COLLAPSE_AFTER_DRAG: Keep every section collapsed after a drag
OPTIONS.COLLAPSE_AFTER_DRAG_HINT: Dragging folds every section into a compact list of drop targets. With this on, they stay folded after the drop (per device); off, they reopen the way they were.
